verdict.rationale: pnpm is documented as a drop-in replacement for npm that works against the standard npm registry ecosystem, letting developers install any existing npm package without migration ('point it at any existing project — no migration, no rewrites'), and community evidence corroborates widespread real-world use installing large dependency trees fast and reliably across many projects/monorepos. Missing for 10: explicit first-party statement about registry scale/maintenance guarantees or independent registry-uptime data, since evidence only implies npm-registry compatibility rather than describing the registry itself.
